rules.statement: A co-owner can make improvements on jointly owned property, and if the improvements are for the exclusive use of one co-owner, that co-owner may be entitled to compensation from the other co-owners in a partition action.
rules.supporting_quote: The right of a common owner extended over the whole property though it was cut down by the existence of the others. Each had the right of enjoyment subject to the concurrent rights of the others : a co-owner could do not act of administration affecting the others against the will of the others : is it without the consent of the others or rather against their prohibition?
